description: Header file defining the OpenCDMSessionPrivate class, which manages DRM session operations including license requests, key status updates, and session management for a media application. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and necessary includes for DRM session handling.

classes.name: OpenCDMSessionPrivate
classes.description: A class implementing DRM session management, including license handling, key status updates, and session lifecycle management, inheriting from OpenCDMSession and IMediaKeysClient.

methods.name: onLicenseRequest
methods.description: Handles license request events, sending license request messages to the server.

methods.name: onLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Handles license renewal events, updating the license as needed.

methods.name: onKeyStatusesChanged
methods.description: Updates internal key status information when key statuses change.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the DRM session, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Generates a license request based on provided init data and cdm data.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the DRM session with a new license.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if a specific key ID is present in the session.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: addProtectionMeta
methods.description: Adds DRM protection metadata to buffers.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current key status for a given key.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Returns the last DRM error code.
